description:
FILED s456af, supersedes the STRUCK tier-2 item N2 (faster-codegen-suggestions.md par.13.1 has the table).  N2 asked for `p-my-=`/`p-scalar-=` to mutate (p-box-value) instead of allocating a fresh box.  p-my-= HAS always expanded to (box-set place value), which mutates -- so N2 was already satisfied and its ~1.3x was never on the table.  But re-measuring the par.3 variants ONE PER SBCL IMAGE (5M iterations) shows something worse: acc0_boxed (fresh box per write) 0.2560s, acc2_boxmut (setf (p-box-value $s) ...) 0.1870s, acc_today (what PCL emits, p-my-= -> box-set) 0.2880s, raw slot 0.0170s.  The par.3 numbers reproduce (0.2237 / 0.1706 / 0.0160), so the harness is sound and the new row is the finding: TODAY IS SLOWER THAN THE VARIANT N2 WANTED TO REPLACE.  The cost is box-set's store-semantics DISPATCH -- tie, magic, dualvar, adjustable-vector, copy semantics -- not allocation: 1.54x over a plain slot mutation, on EVERY still-boxed scalar write in every program.  WORK: a fast path in box-set for "the box carries no tie and no magic and the value is a simple scalar" (number/string, not a vector, not a box, not a dualvar), falling through to the full path otherwise.  Kind-A name suggested: `box-set-fast`.  BAR: this is a cl/ change, so the full sweep is non-optional and the companion op/ leg applies (a coercion/store change); measure with the par.9 recipe, one image per variant.  METHOD TRAP recorded: these variants allocate 5M boxes each, so running them in one image makes the later ones measure the earlier ones' garbage -- a first pass read the raw slot at 0.030s where a fresh image reads 0.017s.

DONE s458ak.  box-set gains a fast path at the top, taken when VALUE is a raw number or string AND the box's CURRENT value is a plain scalar (number/string/nil/undef).  Those two conditions are exactly what makes every later step a no-op, and the comment in the code enumerates them: a raw VALUE fails the (p-box-p value) guard on the copy-semantics unwrap, the class-COPY rule and the dualvar carry-over; it is not a vector or hash table, so neither scalar-context count conversion fires; it is not a typeglob, so the is-ref rule does not; and a plain OLD value means no tie proxy, no magic cell, and a class-CLEAR rule that is itself guarded on the old value being a REF shape.  What is left is the slot write, the two caches, and pos() -- and pos() is now asked for only when *p-match-pos* is non-empty (a REMHASH on every scalar write in every program that never used m//g).  MEASURED with a `my $s=0; my $r=\$s; for (1..5e6) { $s = $s + $_ }` program (the escaping reference defeats the raw-slot verdict, so every write is a box-set): 0.2521 s -> 0.1734 s, -31 %, base = a git archive of main 8e38d79 measured in the same sitting.  That figure also carries #815's box-nv guard, which the same loop reaches.  NOT a Kind-A name: it is a runtime fast path with no emission half, so PCL_OPT has nothing to switch.  Bar met: gate 190/6373, full sweep GATE clean TOTAL 18340 (+0), tie-01.t / magic-vars-01.t / errno-magic-01.t / overload-01.t green.
